heroSummary: The Bambu Lab P1P effortlessly prints eSUN eTPU-95A out of the box using its stock direct drive extruder and stainless steel nozzle without requiring an enclosure. By constraining the volumetric flow rate to 4.5 mm³/s, the machine achieves reliable, jam-free results at a maximum safe print speed of 54 mm/s.
bedSurfaceRecommendation: Textured PEI Plate with glue stick or liquid release agent
slicerTweaks: Set Filament Max Volumetric Speed to 4.5 mm³/s to automatically clamp flow rate across all print moves.
Tune retraction to 0.6 mm distance at 30 mm/s retraction speed with Z-hop disabled to minimize stringing without risking filament jamming.
Enable 'Avoid Crossing Walls' (Max detour length: 0) to keep nozzle travel moves contained within infill boundaries.
Set outer wall speed to 40 mm/s and inner wall speed to 50 mm/s with line width locked to 0.42 mm for consistent wall pressure.

troubleshootingMatrix.issue: Filament wrapping or buckling around extruder gears
troubleshootingMatrix.rootCause: Backpressure caused by excessive print speeds exceeding the 4.5 mm³/s volumetric flow threshold.
troubleshootingMatrix.exactFix: Cap print speed to 54 mm/s, set max volumetric speed to 4.5 mm³/s, and ensure nozzle temperature is at least 220°C.

troubleshootingMatrix.rootCause: High moisture content within the hygroscopic TPU matrix boiling off during extrusion.
troubleshootingMatrix.exactFix: Dry the spool in a filament dryer at 55°C for 6 to 8 hours and print directly from a sealed drybox.

troubleshootingMatrix.issue: Print permanently fused to the build plate
troubleshootingMatrix.rootCause: Direct chemical bonding of molten TPU to clean PEI coating without a barrier interface.
troubleshootingMatrix.exactFix: Apply a uniform layer of PVP glue stick as a sacrificial release agent, and wait until the bed cools to room temperature before removal.

faq.question: Can I feed eSUN eTPU-95A through the Bambu Lab AMS?
faq.answer: No, flexible filaments like eTPU-95A will jam within the AMS feeder funnels and internal tubing; mount the spool on the rear external spool holder.

faq.question: Does printing eSUN eTPU-95A on the P1P require an enclosure?
faq.answer: No, an enclosure is not required and is actually discouraged for TPU, as elevated chamber temperatures can cause premature filament softening and heat creep.

faq.question: Do I need to upgrade to a hardened steel nozzle for eSUN eTPU-95A?
faq.answer: No, eSUN eTPU-95A is completely non-abrasive, making the stock stainless steel nozzle on the P1P fully durable and suitable.

faq.question: What is the recommended method to load TPU into the P1P toolhead?
faq.answer: Preheat the nozzle to 220°C, cut the tip at a 45-degree angle, push it smoothly into the top toolhead inlet until it engages the gears, and tap the display's extrude button while maintaining gentle manual pressure.
